newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates hold steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates hold steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Monday amid low demand from spinners and high unsold stocks at ginneries and brokers said rates were likely to open unchanged on Tuesday.
Stocks of about 1.8 million 375-lb bales at ginneries and low physical offtake had anchored prices for the past week, broker Nasim Usman at the Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
In the kerb market NIAB-78 was quoted at 2,250/2,350 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and MNH-93 at 2,525/2,575 rupees, he said.
